author: Howrah007
body: they add together.. not only def, but also atk and mag and other.. so yes, use spells and potions.. only same arrows "cancel" each other - but the rule here is - the more the merrier :)

author: ElzaxDun
body:
Also...

Arrows up : 
1 = +25%
2 = +50%
3 = +100%

Arrows down : 
1 = -20%
2 = -80%

(This means double up does not negate double down)


And temporary buffs stack with permanent ones

author: Cllydoscope
body: The buffs that start with “T.” are “temporary”, and apply in addition to any permanent buffs you have.

author: zvon2000
body:
One of the best things about this whole game in general is that EVERYTHING stacks!

The more boosts you stack together for any stat, the better it gets, with multiplicative bonuses!
